Name: Choose a permanent Log Cabin Scout domain
Completion criteria: Check availability and naming fit; record the selected domain, registrar, renewal cost, and ownership. Purchase only after the owner chooses and authorizes the cost.

Name: Move the website to that domain
Completion criteria: Configure DNS, CNAME, HTTPS, and apex/www behavior; verify the production site; retain a rollback plan. Use registrar redirects for the old domain if supported.

Name: Complete the domain migration for SEO and integrations
Completion criteria: Update canonical URLs, sitemap, social previews, repository settings, and any Meta OAuth/privacy URLs actually in use; verify old links and search-console setup.

Name: Connect the Instagram profile to the website
Completion criteria: Set the permanent website in the profile link and a clear bio; upload the selected profile icon manually. Verify the link opens the correct site.

Name: Make website and Instagram navigation feel connected
Completion criteria: Audit the existing header link; add useful Instagram links to footer/about or listing context, and define a simple Instagram landing route. Avoid a heavy embedded feed. Verify each route.

Name: Unify the visual brand
Completion criteria: Save editable masters, icon exports, colors, typography, and usage rules; compare the selected icon with similar publishers and refine distinguishing features. Match profile, website, covers, and social previews without cluttering property photos.

Name: Simplify the website around finding cabins
Completion criteria: Review desktop header, cards, photo hierarchy, filters, and original-listing actions; make listings immediately accessible. No new hero, long introductory copy, or dedicated mobile redesign in this phase.

Name: Define one shared listing and content model
Completion criteria: Document stable property IDs, source facts, review dates, photo provenance, captions, slide selections, queue states, and published Instagram IDs/links. Decide which fields remain file-backed initially.

Name: Link published Instagram posts to website listings
Completion criteria: Join publication history to property IDs; show verified post links on relevant cards/detail views and offer an “As seen on Instagram” view. No guessed links or browser-only API secrets.

Name: Build a private operations dashboard
Completion criteria: Secure the operator view; show candidates, stale listings, ready posts, published posts, failures, and last successful jobs. Start read-only; add actions only as needed.

Name: Connect Supabase when the dashboard needs it
Completion criteria: Review the existing schema, migrate a small sample, apply access rules, keep tokens server-side, and preserve stable IDs/history. Document rollback/export. Stay file-backed until persistence needs justify migration.

Name: Expand reliable nationwide discovery
Completion criteria: Improve free-first state rotation, source coverage, log-home evidence, and deduplication. Review a small new batch across several states; measure candidate quality and requests. Do not introduce paid API usage by default.

Name: Maintain listing freshness and accurate facts
Completion criteria: Track last successful checks, changed prices/photos, and unavailable sources; never refresh dates without checking. Decide separately whether to adopt the discussed six-month listing-date window. Avoid automatically removing inactive homes until that policy is chosen.

Name: Streamline photo selection and post preparation
Completion criteria: Offer a gallery picker with four distinct images, mostly exterior and one interior; keep source credits/watermarks, material notes, small cover text, and the agreed caption format. Preview quickly before publishing.

Name: Add monitoring and a publishing recovery runbook
Completion criteria: Surface token expiry, source failures, queue failures, duplicate protection, publishing receipts, and deployment status. Exercise failure/reconciliation paths and retain recoverable backups.

Name: Introduce controlled scheduling
Completion criteria: Start with a visible content calendar and prepared queue. Define cadence, fresh source checks, rate limits, idempotency, stop conditions, and a kill switch. Enable unattended publication only after the owner explicitly chooses it.

Name: Measure useful growth
Completion criteria: Choose low-cost analytics; track Instagram-to-site visits, original-listing clicks, saves, and state interest. Use tagged profile links; establish a baseline before claiming improvements.

Name: Expand useful SEO content
Completion criteria: Add state/location pages only where inventory supports them, strengthen listing metadata/internal links, and verify search indexing on the permanent domain. Avoid thin mass-generated pages.

Name: Create a practical marketing program
Completion criteria: Define a short editorial calendar mixing affordable cabins, distinctive exteriors, and regional finds. Keep a shortlist of Virginia architects/builders/designers, draft collaboration ideas, and test themes against measured results. Following and outreach remain manual unless specifically authorized and supported.

Name: Run a weekly project and backlog review
Completion criteria: Review inventory, published content, failures, spend, and results; select the next item; update statuses and evidence; synchronize the master Notion project. Consider alerts, email digests, or advanced filters only after core usage supports them.
